description_en: Calls UpdateCustomizedFilter to update a custom filter condition
description_zh: 调用UpdateCustomizedFilter更新自定义过滤条件
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc update-customized-filter --black-white-type BLACK --project-id P0VFCREU --name AnotherFilter --value 1,4 --value-type WRITE --value-compare-type NUMBER --id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCustomizedFilter

parameters.help_en:
The type of blacklists and whitelists for comparison. Valid values: 

BLACK: blacklist 
WHITE: whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
比较的黑白名单类型： 

BLACK：黑名单 
WHITE：白名单
parameters.name: black_white_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the filter condition
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The value of the filter condition
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The type of the filter condition value.

The only valid value is WRITE
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件值类型：

唯一取值WRITE
parameters.name: value_type

parameters.help_en:
The comparison type of the value. Valid values:

NUMBER: Compare by number. 
STRING: Compare by string
parameters.help_zh:
值的比较类型：

NUMBER：按数字比较 
STRING：按字符串比较
parameters.name: value_compare_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom filter condition to update
parameters.help_zh: 更新的自定义过滤条件ID
parameters.name: id
